summary: This XML file defines a custom ribbon interface for Microsoft Office, adding a new tab to the ribbon bar with a group containing a button and text input field. When the user clicks the button or changes the text, it triggers callback functions to handle those actions.

explanations.1: This declares an XML document using Microsoft's custom UI schema, which is the standard format for extending Office application interfaces.
explanations.4: The insertAfterMso attribute positions this new tab right after the existing 'View' tab in the ribbon, so users will see it in a familiar location.
explanations.9: imageMso references a built-in Microsoft Office icon library; 'HappyFace' is a predefined icon you can use without providing your own image file.
explanations.11: onAction names a function that will be called when someone clicks this button—you'd define that function elsewhere in your Office add-in code.
explanations.15: onChange names a function that fires whenever the user types or modifies text in this input box.
